findings.label: Acronym plurals leak
findings.detail: "Afiliados FONASAs del sector." and "Pacientes con NSEs distintos." pass rule 1. Use fonasas?, nses? and gses? (like the existing isapres?).

findings.label: "socioeconomía" leaks
findings.detail: "La socioeconomía familiar es precaria." passes because the stem is socio ?economic\w*. Use socio ?econom\w*.

findings.label: Dotted acronyms other than N.S.E. leak
findings.detail: "Afiliado a F.O.N.A.S.A." and "Afiliado a I.S.A.P.R.E." pass (normalized to 'f o n a s a' / 'i s a p r e'). Join runs of single-letter tokens in normalizar() (or test a second joined form); then n ?s ?e can become nses?.

findings.label: n ?s ?e rejects "n° se"
findings.detail: "Cita n° se reprogramó." is rejected as nivel_socioeconomico (fail-closed false positive). Fixed by finding 3's single-letter join plus nses?; add the phrase as a negative example.

findings.label: "En previsión de" rejects
findings.detail: The 'anticipating' sense of previsión is common clinical prose and is rejected (fail-closed, costs a retry). Accept it, or add a prompt line in a NEW prompt version; do not edit v1.2.0 in place.
